deepening_target: Introduce a `Summarizer` Protocol with two adapters (`LiteLLMSummarizer`, `GeminiDirectSummarizer`) and a thin selector. Currently `_summarize_litellm` and `_summarize_gemini_direct` are sibling private functions; the `summarize()` dispatcher chooses between them via `if config.LITELLM_URL ... elif config.GEMINI_API_KEY`. The seam is real (2 adapters) but unnamed. Adding a third provider (Anthropic direct, OpenAI direct) currently requires modifying the dispatcher; with a Protocol, providers register themselves.
rationale: Two real adapters exist for the same conceptual operation (LLM-summarize). Per LANGUAGE.md: 'A real seam has >= 2 adapters' — qualifies. Pull complexity downward: dispatcher becomes one line; provider-specific JSON shapes (Gemini `responseMimeType` vs LiteLLM `response_format`) hide inside the adapters.

deepening_target: Extract `ModelLifecycle` module owning `_model` + `_model_loaded_at` + `load_model()` + `maybe_unload()` + `_mem_available_gb()` + `oom_guard()`. Leaves `transcribe.py` focused on transcription business logic (`local_transcribe`, `groq_transcribe`, `diarize`).
rationale: Three concerns braided: (1) model lifecycle (load/unload, time-based), (2) host monitoring (psutil mem check), (3) actual transcription. The functional-core / imperative-shell split fits naturally: lifecycle is shell-side, transcription functions are core-side given a loaded model.

deepening_target: Extract `_transcribe_with_fallback(audio, lang, allow_cloud, with_diarization)` helper. The 30-line oom_guard → local_transcribe → groq_fallback → optional-diarize block is duplicated verbatim between `run_job` (lines ~65-95) and `run_upload_job` (lines ~130-160). One helper, two callers — clean deep module.
rationale: Real Fowler 'Combine Functions into Function' pattern. The duplication is exact, not similar-looking; the extracted helper would have a clean 4-param interface and ~30 lines of stable logic inside.

deepening_target: Replace `client()` and `rq_client()` with a single `_make_client(decode: bool)` parameterized factory + two thin accessors. Currently identical lazy-init code, only differing in `decode_responses` arg.
rationale: Real duplication, but 8 lines total. Extraction would barely shrink the file. Borderline — note for future if Redis client init grows in complexity.

deepening_target: Split `run_job` (~75 lines) into pure stages: `_resolve_cache()`, `_probe_and_route()`, `_transcribe_pipeline()`, `_finalize_and_cache()`. Each stage testable in isolation; orchestrator is a 10-line sequence.
rationale: Function is long but the pipeline order is its essential complexity — splitting may not earn locality. Mark as future possibility, not v0.1 target.
